what_happened: The job "Run independent plan-group items in parallel in the drain loop" (20261016-185517-qcrz) ended failed at admission, before any work was done. Admission refused the change because athena.toml does not parse. The file has a `[parallel]` table at line 167, and the config schema does not know a `parallel` field. It accepts only athena, models, budget, agents, capabilities, classes, forecast, secrets, tools, history, records, personal_data and landing. No acceptance criteria, blocker or major findings, or failed checks are listed. Nothing was delivered. This is the same error as the earlier job 20261016-071202-q0xy, one line further down. The broken athena.toml was still in place when this job was submitted.
cause: The first failure in this class did not lead to a repair. The broken athena.toml stayed in place, and Athena accepted and queued a second job against it. Admission only refuses a job once it has been submitted. Nothing checks at submit or enqueue time that the config parses. Nothing blocks a retry or a related request while the config is known to be broken. The config file and the schema that parses it are still edited separately. Because the job that needs the schema change cannot be admitted while the config is invalid, the error blocks its own fix. This is a deadlock like the version-pin one.
prevention: Add two code checks. (1) A config-parse check at submit and enqueue time, and again before a job starts. If athena.toml fails to parse under the current schema, refuse the request at once with the parse error and say it is the same cause as the earlier failure. Do not queue work behind a broken config. (2) A check run on any change to athena.toml, in a job or by hand, that parses the file under the schema from the same change. Reject a commit where a new section has no matching schema field. The schema field and its config section must land together: the schema accepts `parallel` first, or both are added in one change. The broken file must also be repaired once, by removing or reverting the `[parallel]` table.
proposed_request: Repair athena.toml so it parses, and make config and schema changes land together. Outcome: (1) athena.toml parses under the current schema. Either remove the `[parallel]` table, or add a `parallel` field to the config schema with documented defaults, whichever keeps parallel drain work possible, and the file loads with no unknown-field error. (2) Submit and enqueue refuse a request with a clear message naming the parse error when athena.toml does not parse, instead of admitting the job and failing it later. (3) A test or check fails if athena.toml contains any top-level section the schema does not accept, and this check runs in the normal gate (cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets, cargo fmt --check). Acceptance: a test with a config that has an unknown section shows the refusal at submit time, and the real athena.toml loads cleanly. After this lands, re-submit "Run independent plan-group items in parallel in the drain loop" so that the `parallel` schema field and the `[parallel]` config are added in the same change.
